rows.ja: 電力・合弁パートナー
競合(アルコアの10-Kに記載)

relations.text: 無炭素製錬技術の合弁ELYSISを折半出資(各48.235%)
relations.text_en: Equal partner (48.235% each) in the ELYSIS zero-carbon smelting venture

source.label: Alcoa 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: ELYSIS ELYSIS ® Limited Partnership (ELYSIS) is between wholly-owned subsidiaries of Alcoa (48.235%) and Rio Tinto Alcan Inc.

relations.text: アルコアが10-Kで、アルミナ・地金の競合として挙げる
relations.text_en: Alcoa names Rio Tinto among alumina and aluminum competitors

source.label: Alcoa 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: We compete with commodity traders, a growing number of refineries in Asia (especially in China and Indonesia), and other alumina producers, such as South32, Rio Tinto, and Glencore.

relations.text: ブラジルのAlumar製錬所を共同保有(South32が40%)
relations.text_en: Co-owns the Alumar smelter in Brazil (South32 holds 40%)

source.label: Alcoa 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: The smelter and casthouse are owned by Alcoa Alumínio (60%) and South32 (40%).

relations.text: サウジ合弁の持分25.1%をMa'aden株と引き換えに売却(2025年7月)
relations.text_en: Sold its 25.1% Saudi joint venture stake to Ma'aden for shares (July 2025)

source.label: Alcoa 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: In July 2025, Alcoa completed the sale of its full ownership interest of 25.1% in the Saudi Arabia joint venture, to Saudi Arabian Mining Company (Ma'aden)

companies.name: トレント・エクイティ

relations.text: スペインのSan Ciprián工場を支える合弁(アルコア75%)
relations.text_en: Joint venture to keep the San Ciprián complex in Spain running (Alcoa 75%)

source.label: Alcoa 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: On March 31, 2025, Alcoa and Trento Equity Holdings, S.L.U. (Trento EQT), formerly known as IGNIS Equity Holdings, SL, entered into a joint venture agreement

relations.text: アイスランドの製錬所に水力電力を40年契約で供給
relations.text_en: Supplies hydroelectric power to its Iceland smelter under a 40-year contract

source.label: Alcoa 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Iceland Landsvirkjun, the Icelandic national power company, supplies competitively priced electricity from a hydroelectric facility to the smelter under a 40-year power contract

companies.name: アルミナ・リミテッド

relations.text: AWAC合弁の40%を持っていたAlumina社を2024年8月に買収
relations.text_en: Acquired Alumina Limited, its 40% AWAC partner, in August 2024

source.label: Alcoa 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Alumina Limited Acquisition On August 1, 2024, Alcoa completed the acquisition of all of the ordinary shares of Alumina Limited

companies.name: ハウメット・エアロスペース

relations.text: 旧アルコアから分かれた会社。「Alcoa」商標をホイールに使う独占ライセンスを持つ
relations.text_en: Split from the former Alcoa; exclusive licensee of the Alcoa name for wheels

source.label: Howmet Aerospace 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: pursuant to a Trademark License Agreement, is the exclusive licensee of the "Alcoa" name and logo for use with the wheels, hubs, and related products that we manufacture.

companies.name: カイザー・アルミナム

relations.text: Warrick圧延工場の独立に向け、アルコアが電力インフラ整備費を負担
relations.text_en: Alcoa pays for power infrastructure to make Kaiser's Warrick mill self-sufficient

source.label: Kaiser Aluminum 10-K(2024年度)
source.quote: Alcoa has agreed to pay for the development of infrastructure necessary for Warrick to obtain electricity from a third-party power supplier

relations.text: テキサス州Rockdaleのアルコア旧工場用地をデータセンターとして賃借
relations.text_en: Leases its Rockdale, Texas datacenter site from Alcoa

source.label: Bitdeer 20-F(2025年度)
source.quote: Lease Agreement for the Datacenter in Rockdale, Texas In June 2018, Dory Creek, LLC, our subsidiary, entered into the Lease Agreement with Alcoa USA Corp.

companies.name: センチュリー・アルミナム

relations.text: アルコアが10-Kで、地金の競合として挙げる
relations.text_en: Alcoa names Century among aluminum competitors

source.label: Alcoa 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: aluminum producers, such as Emirates Global Aluminum, Norsk Hydro ASA, Rio Tinto, Century Aluminum, and Vedanta Aluminum Ltd.
